articles.title: Tesla Stock Set to Snap 8-Week Losing Streak—Just in Time For Earnings
articles.mainIdea: Tesla Stock Set to Snap 8-Week Losing Streak—Just in Time For Earnings
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Tesla Stock Set to Snap 8-Week Losing Streak—Just in Time For Earnings. Tesla stock was advancing early Friday and is on course to snap an extended losing streak. Shares in the electric-vehicle maker were up 1.4% to $394.53 in premarket trading. Alongside broader equity markets, Tesla stock appears to have been lifted by news earlier in the week that the U.S. and Iran are looking to extend their two-week cease-fire beyond April 22. Related tickers mentioned: F, TSLA, ^IXIC.
